#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n, b;
    scanf("%d %d", &n, &b);
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        scanf("%d", &a[i]);
    }
    
    vector<int> diff;
    int even = (a[0] % 2 == 0) ? 1 : 0;
    int odd = (a[0] % 2 == 1) ? 1 : 0;
    
    for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
        if (even == odd) {
            diff.push_back(abs(a[i] - a[i-1]));
        }
        if (a[i] % 2 == 0) {
            ++even;
        } else {
            ++odd;
        }
    }
    
    sort(diff.begin(), diff.end());
    
    long long sum = 0;
    int count = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < diff.size(); ++i) {
        if (sum + diff[i] <= b) {
            ++count;
            sum += diff[i];
        }
    }
    
    printf("%d\n", count);
    return 0;
}
